title: The Microsoft 365 Interface & Ribbon
description: Understand tabs, commands, quick access toolbar, and cloud auto-save concepts across Office apps.
objectives: Understand the Ribbon layout shared across Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Use Quick Access Toolbar & Search bar
Enable AutoSave for OneDrive cloud storage

steps.title: Unified Ribbon Design
steps.content: All Microsoft 365 applications use a standard Ribbon design divided into Tabs (Home, Insert, Layout), Groups, and Commands.

quiz.question: What is the primary benefit of enabling AutoSave in Microsoft 365?
options: Changes are saved continuously in real-time to OneDrive cloud storage
It automatically emails copies to your manager
quiz.explanation: AutoSave continuously saves your edits to OneDrive or SharePoint so you never lose work.
